source: Agreed project conversation; reconstructed as repository records.
timeline_note: Relative concentration windows, not delivery promises or gate evidence.

gates.title: Core0, LLVM lowering and LemmaVM
gates.exit_requirement: Audited freestanding execution of the declared Core0 profile.

gates.title: Boot, runtime, traps, memory and scheduling
gates.exit_requirement: Isolated managed-Lean processes with controlled faults and resource limits.

gates.title: Capabilities, IPC and persistent storage
gates.exit_requirement: Enforced authority and recoverable acknowledged records within a stated failure model.

gates.title: Pen, display, ink and mathematical documents
gates.exit_requirement: Write, edit, save, restart and replay an offline notebook.

gates.title: Exact checking and proof checking
gates.exit_requirement: Correctly scoped, version-bound and reproducible mathematical evidence.

gates.title: Semantic textbooks and learner state
gates.exit_requirement: A coherent offline learning sequence with traceable observations and recommendations.

gates.title: Networking, tutor and learning-policy optimization
gates.exit_requirement: Permissioned connected assistance with offline fallback and separately evaluated learning outcomes.

units.title: Architecture and trust baseline
units.required_evidence: Reviewed manifests of architecture, ABI, allowed primitives and host/target trust.

units.title: Versioned LemmaVM contract
units.required_evidence: Pinned launcher and machine conformance; explicit incompatible-feature failures.

units.title: Core0 membership checker
units.required_evidence: Accepted and rejected elaborated declarations, including indirect forbidden dependencies.

units.title: Core0 executable semantics
units.required_evidence: Lean reference results for defined arithmetic, layout, memory and primitive boundary cases.

units.title: LLVM lowering audit and implementation
units.required_evidence: Inspectable supported lowerings and pre/post-optimization runtime dependency accounting.

units.title: Lean-authored machine primitives
units.required_evidence: Disassembly and execution check entry, registers, MMIO and ordering contracts.

units.title: Freestanding image construction
units.required_evidence: Actual ELF boot with linker map, relocations, static initialization and complete provenance.

units.title: Compiler conformance suite
units.required_evidence: Differential optimized/unoptimized target runs; deliberately defective lowerings are detected.

units.title: Boot and machine-mode services
units.required_evidence: Cold boot, declared firmware handoff, valid stacks and supervisor entry.

units.title: Traps, timers and diagnostics
units.required_evidence: Injected interrupts/faults with correct identification, saved state and return.

units.title: Frames and address spaces
units.required_evidence: Page permissions, guard pages and cross-process/kernel isolation tests.

units.title: Task contexts and user execution
units.required_evidence: Repeated process switches without register or floating-point-state leakage.

units.title: Explicit allocators and limits
units.required_evidence: Alignment, ownership/accounting and controlled exhaustion under stress.

units.title: Managed Lean runtime
units.required_evidence: Representative ordinary Lean without importing upstream C/C++ target runtime.

units.title: Scheduling and reclamation
units.required_evidence: Preemption, quotas, cancellation and bounded cleanup preserve specified service budgets.

units.title: Runtime and isolation qualification
units.required_evidence: Combined crash, cancellation and exhaustion tests preserve unaffected tasks and recovery.

units.title: Capability model
units.required_evidence: Explicit grant/attenuation/revocation model with proofs or tests appropriately labelled.

units.title: Capability enforcement
units.required_evidence: Forged, stale and cross-process handles fail at kernel boundaries.

units.title: Bounded IPC
units.required_evidence: Malformed requests, queue bounds, cancellation and process death preserve authority/accounting.

units.title: Device broker and virtual-device foundation
units.required_evidence: Negotiation, descriptor/buffer ownership and invalid-completion tests; DMA trust explicit.

units.title: Block-device persistence contract
units.required_evidence: Reads/writes/flush/error model with reproducible simulated interruptions.

units.title: Recoverable journal
units.required_evidence: Acknowledged commits survive allowed interruption schedules without invented records.

units.title: Object store and migration
units.required_evidence: Interrupted compaction, transactions and schema changes retain recoverable committed content.

units.title: Authority and durability qualification
units.required_evidence: Unauthorized writes fail and crash campaigns recover an allowed committed history.

units.title: Input and display contracts
units.required_evidence: Coordinate/time/mode/completion negotiation and explicit unsupported operations.

units.title: VirtualEPD and pen replay
units.required_evidence: Recorded input/clock/completion traces reproduce semantic document state.

units.title: Ink geometry
units.required_evidence: Raw samples preserved; smoothing/prediction remains derived and replayable.

units.title: Rendering and mathematical layout
units.required_evidence: Rasterization, clipping, transforms and notation corpus work at supported scales.

units.title: Pen-first shell
units.required_evidence: Page creation/editing/navigation works without recognition or an attached keyboard.

units.title: Mathematical document model
units.required_evidence: Ink, typed expressions, annotations and source anchors retain consistent revision identity.

units.title: Autosave and document recovery
units.required_evidence: Pending/committed state is visible and acknowledged edits survive restart/replay.

units.title: Offline-writing qualification
units.required_evidence: Sustained writing under CPU/memory/storage/display pressure without a network.

units.title: Exercise contract
units.required_evidence: Goal, domain, assumptions, methods, verifier and assistance policy pinned per submission.

units.title: Restricted exact checkers
units.required_evidence: Reproducible scoped arithmetic/algebra checking with preserved side conditions and explicit unsupported cases.

units.title: Lean-authored proof-kernel port
units.required_evidence: Native checking of a pinned theorem corpus and its full environment/dependency closure.

units.title: Trusted environments and axiom policy
units.required_evidence: Forged imports, altered goals and prohibited assumptions cannot produce Verified evidence.

units.title: Structured proof construction
units.required_evidence: Generated proof terms check against the original exact exercise goal.

units.title: Recognition proposal boundary
units.required_evidence: Ambiguous interpretations retain raw ink and require explicit clarification; fixtures first.

units.title: Evidence ledger
units.required_evidence: Results bind exact submissions/revisions/environments/checkers/limits; edits invalidate prior applicability.

units.title: Verification qualification
units.required_evidence: Adversarial proof/answer corpus preserves Verified/Invalid/NeedsClarification/Unsupported/Indeterminate distinctions.

units.title: Semantic textbook schema
units.required_evidence: Edition/source/rights anchors, concepts, examples and exercise references remain navigable.

units.title: Content compiler and packages
units.required_evidence: Immutable offline packages resolve every asset, exercise and checker reference.

units.title: Prerequisite and scope graph
units.required_evidence: Logical dependencies and pedagogical prerequisites are separate and inspectable.

units.title: Complete reference learning sequence
units.required_evidence: A coherent sequence contains no missing material or advertised-but-unsupported checks.

units.title: Learner-event log
units.required_evidence: Attempts, hints, corrections, abandonment and observed assistance have traceable origins.

units.title: Learner-state estimator
units.required_evidence: Same event history and model version reconstruct the same uncertain estimates.

units.title: Transparent baseline review policy
units.required_evidence: Recommendations are reproducible, explainable, overridable and work without a trained model.

units.title: Assessment and retention framework
units.required_evidence: Held-out/delayed/transfer tasks and fixed scoring remain outside ordinary tutor/policy authority.

units.title: Native networking substrate
units.required_evidence: Bounded transport/protocol tests tolerate loss, malformed traffic and disconnects.

units.title: Cryptography, identity and safe updates
units.required_evidence: Entropy/authentication/credential boundaries and interrupted-update recovery with reviewed evidence.

units.title: Permissioned remote-service protocol
units.required_evidence: Only authorized context leaves device; bounded streams, retries and cancellation preserve writing.

units.title: Tutor and recognizer adapters
units.required_evidence: Untrusted outputs remain proposals; actual responses/context/version information are recorded.

units.title: Bounded assistance orchestration
units.required_evidence: Tutor cannot alter evidence, grant itself rights or access prohibited assessment material.

units.title: Constrained learned-policy pipeline
units.required_evidence: Policies use fixed action/reward contracts and can be replayed, compared, disabled and rolled back.

units.title: Learning-outcome evaluation
units.required_evidence: Delayed independent performance/transfer with comparable time budgets and uncertainty; no proxy-only success claims.

units.title: Whole-system qualification
units.required_evidence: Complete sessions tolerate service failures, malicious content, limits and restart without fabricated evidence/data loss.

units.title: Physical board boot and firmware boundary
units.required_evidence: Inventory ROM/DDR/clock/firmware handoff and reach the common supervisor contract.

units.title: Physical interrupts, storage and DMA
units.required_evidence: Shared conformance plus physical interruption tests and explicit DMA isolation assumptions.

units.title: OEM/FPGA protocol integration
units.required_evidence: Actual supplier part/revision/interface package; modes/commands/reset/calibration/fault semantics frozen against it.
external_prerequisites: Actual supplier-confirmed cartridge and interface/waveform/calibration package

units.title: Native pen input and registration
units.required_evidence: Full-area actual reporting, registration, pressure/tip detection, dropouts and recovery.

units.title: Physical display and networking backends
units.required_evidence: Shared semantic interface tests and simultaneous physical load operation.

units.title: Physical parity and visible-ink qualification
units.required_evidence: Actual document/evidence parity, end-to-end pen latency and physical recovery measurements.
